variable.name: DEBUG_STATUS
variable.label: DEBUG_STATUS
variable.description: Current debug status of the server

variable.name: CCC_VAULT_ADMIN_GROUP
variable.label: CCC_VAULT_ADMIN_GROUP
variable.abstract: The group containing the CCC internal UKO Vault Administrator
variable.description: Group containing the Valut Administrator who sets up and manages vaults.

variable.name: CCC_KEY_ADMIN_GROUP
variable.label: CCC_KEY_ADMIN_GROUP
variable.abstract: The group containing the CCC internal UKO Key Administrator
variable.description: Group containing the Key Administrator who sets up the key hierarchy, and controls keystores and templates, as well as performs special key state actions.

variable.name: CCC_KEY_CUSTODIAN1_GROUP
variable.label: CCC_KEY_CUSTODIAN1_GROUP
variable.abstract: The group holding the first CCC internal UKO Key Custodians
variable.description: Group for Key Custodians who can generate keys in PRE-ACTIVATION state, but cannot Activate and Distribute them. Destroy and Compromise actions are also possible.

variable.name: CCC_KEY_CUSTODIAN2_GROUP
variable.label: CCC_KEY_CUSTODIAN2_GROUP
variable.abstract: The group holding the second CCC internal UKO Key Custodians
variable.description: The group holding the Key Custodians who cannot Generate, but can Activate keys bringing them from PRE-ACTIVATION to ACTIVE state (then distributes them). Destroy and Compromise actions are also possible.

variable.name: CCC_AUDITOR_GROUP
variable.label: CCC_AUDITOR_GROUP
variable.abstract: The group holding the CCC internal UKO Auditors
variable.description: The group holding the auditors who can view the audit log as well as keystores, templates, keys, and status of dataset encryption.
